name: call-recorder
description: Search and read your recorded calls (AI notes, full transcripts, your own notes and action items) straight from the Call Recorder app on this Mac.
long_description: Asks the Call Recorder app running on this Mac, so Claude always sees your latest calls and nothing is copied anywhere else. The extension reads none of your files itself: Call Recorder does, with the access it already has. Calls you delete in Call Recorder disappear here too. Call Recorder needs to be running.

tools.name: search_calls
tools.description: Search every recorded call (titles, people, AI notes, your notes, transcripts) and return the matching passages.

tools.name: list_calls
tools.description: List recorded calls, newest first, with who was on them and a summary.

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Read one call's notes or its full timestamped transcript.

tools.name: list_action_items
tools.description: Action items from recorded calls, filterable by owner and date.
